title: Reference Standards for Cardiorespiratory Fitness Measured With Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing
population: FRIEND registry adults with CPET-measured CRF

keyFinding.enGB: Age- and sex-specific VO2 reference percentiles from the FRIEND registry provide norms for cardiorespiratory fitness interpretation.
